_comment: Declares the intended repository visibility policy for the pre-push audit. allow_public=true means the owner has intentionally launched MACSPLOIT publicly: the audit no longer requires the canonical destination to be PRIVATE, but it still verifies the canonical destination and rejects secrets, sensitive data, and unexpected remotes. Set this back to false to re-enforce a PRIVATE-only destination. See docs/releases/v0.1.0.md.
